Cors.//: Origins allowed to call this service from a browser. The console's live client no longer connects here itself — its server-side relay does — so this is now belt and braces on top of the token /hubs/stock requires. Development allows any origin; an empty list means no browser may call this service cross-origin at all.

Jwt.//: The tokens this service accepts, issued by the Identity service: same issuer, audience and signing key. A real deployment sets Jwt__SigningKey and the service refuses to start on the published development key in Production.

RabbitMq.//: Matches docker-compose.yml. Override with RabbitMq__HostName etc., or set Enabled=false to keep events in the outbox without a broker.

Outbox.//: The dispatcher drains OutboxMessages to RabbitMQ. Backoff is exponential and capped; there is no attempt limit, so an event leaves the outbox only once the broker has confirmed it.
